lines.text: Many learners say: Where is the remocon?
Remocon is not an English word.

data.why: Remocon is not an English word.

native.tip: ‘리모컨’은 한국식 줄임말이에요. 영어로는 remote! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “Where is the remote?”
native.caption: “Where is the remocon”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘리모컨’은 한국식 줄임말이라서 영어로는 잘 통하지 않아요. 영어로는 remote라고 해요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “Where is the remote?” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: “Remocon” is not English. Say remote. Say “Where is the remote?”
en.caption: Do you say “Where is the remocon” in English? 😅 Remocon is not an English word, so say remote! “Where is the remote” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
